# qdrant-cloud_serverless_backup (Resource)

Serverless Backup Resource (one-off backup of a serverless space)

## Example Usage

```terraform
// Setup Terraform, including the qdrant-cloud providers
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.7.0"
  required_providers {
    qdrant-cloud = {
      source  = "qdrant/qdrant-cloud"
      version = ">=1.1.0"
    }
  }
}

// Add the provider to specify some provider wide settings
provider "qdrant-cloud" {
  api_key    = "" // API Key generated in Qdrant Cloud (required)
  account_id = "" // The default account ID you want to use in Qdrant Cloud (can be overriden on resource level)
}

// Pick the first available serverless cloud region
data "qdrant-cloud_serverless_cloud_regions" "all" {}
locals {
  cloud_region_id = [for r in data.qdrant-cloud_serverless_cloud_regions.all.regions : r.id if r.available][0]
}

// Create a serverless space
resource "qdrant-cloud_serverless_space" "example" {
  name            = "example-space"
  cloud_region_id = local.cloud_region_id
}

// Create a manual backup of the entire space
resource "qdrant-cloud_serverless_backup" "example" {
  space_id         = qdrant-cloud_serverless_space.example.id
  retention_period = "72h" // Retain for 3 days
}

// Restore the backup into a new space
resource "qdrant-cloud_serverless_space" "restored" {
  name           = "example-space-restored"
  from_backup_id = qdrant-cloud_serverless_backup.example.id
}

// Output the Backup ID
output "backup_id" {
  value = qdrant-cloud_serverless_backup.example.id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) Serverless Backup Schema ID of the serverless space to back up field

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Serverless Backup Schema Account ID (defaults to the provider account ID) field
- `collection_name` (String) Serverless Backup Schema Name of the collection to back up. If unset, the entire space is backed up field
- `retention_period` (String) Serverless Backup Schema Retention period of the backup, as a Go duration string between `24h` and `8760h`. If unset, the backup is retained indefinitely field
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `backup_schedule_id` (String) Serverless Backup Schema ID of the backup schedule that created the backup (empty for manual backups) field
- `created_at` (String) Serverless Backup Schema Creation time field
- `id` (String) Serverless Backup Schema Backup ID, can be used as `from_backup_id` of a serverless space field
- `name` (String) Serverless Backup Schema Name of the backup (generated) field
- `stats` (List of Object) Serverless Backup Schema Statistics of the backup field (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stats))
- `status` (String) Serverless Backup Schema Current status of the backup field

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)

## Import

`qdrant-cloud_serverless_backup` can be imported using the backup ID, e.g.

```
$ terraform import qdrant-cloud_serverless_backup.example 12345678-0000-0000-0000-1234567890ab
```
